errors.error_description: Drove an input port using a continuous assignment by assigning an internal signal to input wire op_a.
Created an unintentional latch by using an incomplete case statement on opcode[1:0] that does not assign flag_v_sel in all branches and lacks a default.
Assigned a 16-bit vector (wide_bus) to an 8-bit signal (narrow), causing truncation.
Instantiated an 8-bit adder sub-module and connected 16-bit signals op_a and op_b to its 8-bit ports, causing port width mismatches at the instance boundary.
